investigation_notes.Script Intent: Retrieves the Authenticode signature of C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe, converts it to JSON and encodes the output in Base64.
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command executed by GoogleUpdate.exe on WKSTN-PROD-11 retrieved and Base64-encoded the Authenticode signature of chrome.exe. The initiating process hash has no detections on VirusTotal and the parent process is services.exe; no external IPs or malicious indicators were observed and no recent related events or similar alerts were found. The alert lacks an explicit file path field which may reflect a logging limitation rather than malicious in-memory-only behavior. Given the benign script intent, trusted updater parent, and clean reputation, this is assessed as Low Priority.
